selection_process: The University will conduct a Screening Test to shortlist candidates as per requirements; call letters for the screening test/interview will be sent only to shortlisted candidates by email. Interviews will be conducted only in physical mode. Selection for all posts is based on the candidate’s overall record and performance in the interview. The University may restrict the number of candidates called for interview based on the screening test and/or experience higher than the minimum prescribed
as decided by the Scrutiny Committee. Meeting the minimum prescribed qualifications does not
entitle a candidate to be called for a screening test or interview. No correspondence will be entertained with candidates who are not shortlisted for interview.
how_to_apply: Visit the official TSU careers portal at https://tsu.ac.in/careers/careers.php.
Select the post you wish to apply for and complete the online application form.

Upload supporting documents, including proof of educational qualification, experience, category (if applicable), and any documents related to a change of name (Marriage Certificate, Gazette notification, Aadhaar Card).
Review all details carefully before final submission, as incomplete applications will not be considered.
Submit the application well before the last date, i.e., 30th September 2026, 23:59 hrs, to avoid last-minute issues.

Candidates already in Government/Semi-Government/PSU service must submit a No Objection Certificate and Vigilance Clearance Certificate from their employer at the time of interview/document verification, or intimate their employer in advance as per applicable rules.
important_instructions: Only online applications through the official TSU website will be accepted; no other mode of application is mentioned in the notification. The engagement is for a period of three years on consolidated pay, or through deputation where applicable. Candidates must produce all original documents relating to qualifications, category, and experience at the time of interview/document verification, failing which their candidature stands cancelled. Selected candidates may be placed at any Campus of the University, and such appointment is transferable across all Campuses. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview/written test/screening test. Candidates holding degrees/diplomas from institutions declared fake or derecognised by the UGC are not eligible. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate from consideration. Selected candidates must produce a medical fitness certificate from the University-specified medical board, except PwBD (Divyang) candidates as applicable. Any dispute, suit, or legal proceeding against the University is subject to the jurisdiction of the Courts of Gujarat, Anand/Ahmedabad. Candidates are advised to regularly check the official website www.tsu.ac.in and their email (including spam folders) for updates on the selection process. For queries, applicants may write to [email protected].

faq.question: Q1. What is TSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: TSU Recruitment 2026 is the recruitment drive by “Tribhuvan” Sahkari University to fill 17 posts on a contractual basis (some open to deputation), including Senior Officer, Assistant Registrar, Consultant, Executive Engineer, Manager Placement, and Resident Engineer.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in TSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 17 vacancies in total, with 1 post in each of the 17 named positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for TSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application portal closes at 23:59 hrs on 30th September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for TSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification requirements vary by post - most Senior Officer, Consultant, and Assistant Registrar posts require a Bachelor’s Degree with an MBA/PG Diploma in a relevant discipline (or CA/ICWA/M.Com for finance-related posts), while engineering posts require a Bachelor’s Degree in Civil/Electrical/Architectural Engineering. See the post-wise qualification table above for details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for TSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit ranges from 40 to 50 years depending on the post, with relaxation for SC/ST/OBC, Disabled, and Ex-servicemen candidates as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply online for TSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply through the official careers portal at https://tsu.ac.in/careers/careers.php before the last date.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for TSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection involves a Screening Test (for shortlisting) followed by a physical-mode Interview, with final selection based on overall record and interview performance.

faq.question: Q8. What is the nature and duration of these TSU posts?
faq.answer: Most posts are contractual for a period of three years; several Assistant Registrar posts and the Manager Placement post are also open to appointment through deputation.
